projects.name: Architectarium
projects.summary: Public architectural research collection with a sourced component ontology, individual building dossiers, and an interactive gallery featuring a schematic Parthenon study.

projects.name: Chromalect
projects.summary: Work-in-progress research laboratory for reversible visual encoding of written and spoken language, with an independent multilingual ontology and a source-aligned Mandarin character atlas.

projects.name: Nomos
projects.summary: Work-in-progress public rule ontology and browser-based instruction composer, with independently addressable rules, virtual groups, structured normative metadata and conflict analysis.

projects.name: Stratlas
projects.summary: Public metropolitan and city geographic research atlas. Metropolitan regions are research specimens; interactive maps organize source-backed geography, infrastructure, land use, demographics, parcel assessments and other available regional data.

projects.name: Urbarium
projects.summary: Work-in-progress geographic 3D city reconstruction, using source-derived building footprints, terrain and transport geometry. Its Downtown Los Angeles viewer is an incomplete research pilot.
